name: manual_c0b337
claim: A tool with multiple entry paths into the same durable record (e.g. an auto-derived path and a manual-override path) needs identical side effects on every path, or referential-integrity gaps will surface much later via something unrelated to the original write, rather than at the point where the gap was actually introduced.

decisions.notes: learn.py's manual-stage path wrote a candidate JSON promising an episodic evidence record via evidence_ids: [now], but never actually wrote that record -- unlike the auto-derived candidate path, which does mirror correctly. The gap sat undetected for a day until an unrelated PR carrying the lesson forward got a CodeRabbit referential-integrity review. Fixed by adding the same mirror write to the manual path.
